study_identification_part.si_4_title: Normative Modeling of Brain Morphometry in Clinical High Risk for Psychosis

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: This study used pooled data from 29 international sites participating in the ENIGMA Clinical High Risk for Psychosis Working Group (ENIGMA-CHR-P). The normative models were derived from an independent external reference sample (CentileBrain) consisting of 37,407 healthy individuals from multiple sites. Since the normative model was pre-trained on an independent external dataset and applied to the ENIGMA CHR-P sample, the study used a 'None (Pre-Trained NM)' approach for normative modeling construction.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "the normative models for each regional measure in the framework were developed using data from an independent multisite sample of 37 407 healthy individuals (53.3% female; aged 3-90 years)" ... "The model parameters in the normative framework (CentileBrain) were then applied to each regional CT, SA, and SV measure of the individuals with CHR-P and healthy individuals in the ENIGMA sample."
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Haas2024.pdf.md: Normative Modeling of Brain Morphometry, L69; Computing Deviation Scores, L113

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The ENIGMA CHR-P pooled dataset was used as the target sample to which the pre-trained CentileBrain normative models were applied. The healthy individuals in the ENIGMA sample served as a comparison group for the CHR-P individuals. The CentileBrain normative models were trained on an independent reference sample of 37,407 healthy individuals from prior work (Ge et al. 2023), not re-trained in this study.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Sex-specific normative models for each neuroimaging software (FreeSurfer)-derived regional CT, SA, and SV measure... were generated using a normative modeling framework for neuroimaging measures that belongs to the category of standard life charts (CentileBrain)... the normative models for each regional measure in the framework were developed using data from an independent multisite sample of 37 407 healthy individuals"

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The study used pre-trained CentileBrain normative models developed from an independent external sample of 37,407 healthy individuals. The ENIGMA CHR-P study sample (1237 healthy individuals) was not used for training; they were the test/application sample. Since the normative model was pre-trained externally and no train/validation/test split was applied within this study's sample, both overall-phase and train-phase refer to the external CentileBrain reference sample.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The normative model was pre-trained on an external CentileBrain reference sample of 37,407 healthy individuals. The paper only reports that participants were 'aged 3-90 years'. Mean, SD, median, and IQR were not reported for this reference sample. Since it is an external pre-trained model, the study sample (ENIGMA CHR-P healthy individuals with mean age 22.32 years, SD 4.95) was not used for training.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The normative model reference sample included 37,407 healthy individuals with 53.3% female. Male N and percentage were inferred: 37407 * 0.533 = 19936 female; 37407 - 19936 = 17471 male (46.7%). Since the normative model is pre-trained externally, the ENIGMA study sample sex distribution (which is 44.70% female for healthy individuals) is not used for model training.
